title: Architectural tactics connect concerns to controls
lead: Use explicit mechanisms to address uncertainty, change, recovery, and auditability.
bullets: Separation isolates data preparation, model execution, and business policy.
Observation makes operational and predictive behavior reviewable.
Recovery restores a compatible path rather than only one artifact.
Governance links evidence, approval, access, and responsibility.
example: A validation boundary contains a bad CRM batch; version links and approvals support controlled repair.
takeaway: A tactic is credible when its mechanism, owner, and evidence are clear.
